name: Sheraton Maui Resort & Spa
insider_take: Perched on the sacred Black Rock at Ka'anapali Beach, this oceanfront paradise sits where ancient Hawaiian chiefs once leaped into the spirit world.
whats_special: The resort's stunning location on Pu'u Keka'a (Black Rock) isn't just scenic—it's one of Maui's most revered snorkeling spots where green sea turtles glide through crystal-clear waters. The property features cliff-side pools that seem to spill into the Pacific and offers front-row seats to Maui's legendary sunsets that paint the sky in brilliant oranges and purples.
pro_tip: Time your arrival at Black Rock for the daily cliff diving ceremony at sunset—a moving tribute to the ancient Hawaiian tradition where warriors would leap from this very spot to prove their courage.
dont_miss: Snorkeling at Black Rock is absolutely essential—the lava rock formation creates a protected lagoon teeming with tropical fish and Hawaiian green sea turtles. Also explore the resort's authentic Polynesian luau and take the short walk along Ka'anapali Beach to Whalers Village for shopping and dining with ocean views.
pros: Prime beachfront location on Ka'anapali Beach
Full-service spa and multiple dining options
Black Rock snorkeling spot directly on property
cons: Large resort property with potential for crowds
